subject.title: fix(session-memory): forward hook config model to LLM slug generator

question: Should OpenClaw accept `hooks.internal.entries.session-memory.model` as a supported hook-level config contract for LLM slug generation?
rationale: The code path is narrow and reuses the embedded runner resolver, but the change turns a previously ignored passthrough key into user-visible provider/model routing behavior.

options.title: Accept Hook Model Contract
options.body: Treat `session-memory.model` as intentional supported config and land this PR once normal checks are green.

options.title: Require Clearer Upgrade Docs
options.body: Ask for public docs or release-note context before merge so the newly consumed key and upgrade effect are explicit.

options.title: Pause This Direction
options.body: Hold or close the PR if maintainers do not want a hook-level model setting to become the supported slug-routing API.

recommendation.title: Accept Hook Model Contract
recommendation.body: Treat `session-memory.model` as intentional supported config and land this PR once normal checks are green.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session-memory handler work plus adjacent model-routing committer history make this the strongest available owner for accepting the config contract.
